shortDefinition.en: A factor-of-two comparison: one stop more doubles the specified quantity and one stop less halves it.
shortDefinition.zh-cn: 以二倍为基准的比较：多一档使指定量翻倍，少一档使其减半。

en: Equal brightness compensation does not make motion, depth of field, and noise identical.
zh-cn: 相同的亮度补偿不会让运动、景深与噪点完全相同。

example.en: Two stops less exposure time means one quarter of the original duration.
example.zh-cn: 少两档曝光时间表示时长变为原来的四分之一。

sources.title: Camera Exposure — Cambridge in Colour
sources.supports: Doubling and halving as the basis of exposure-stop comparisons.
